label: ZKN_SUN_010_000
text:
When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by
releasing a terrifically strong odor from its
antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

label: ZKN_SUN_011_000
text:
Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn’t
move much because of the risk it might
carelessly spill its innards out.

label: ZKN_SUN_012_000
text:
Close examination of its large eyes reveals that
each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

label: ZKN_SUN_019_000
text:
Its incisors continue growing until its death.
If its Trainer doesn’t offer it a file to gnaw on, it
will gnaw on door frames, table legs, and so on.

label: ZKN_SUN_020_000
text:
Its hind feet are webbed, so it’s a strong
swimmer. It can cross rivers and sometimes
even oceans.

label: ZKN_SUN_021_000
text:
Its short wings make it inept at flying.
It moves about hurriedly and pecks at
Bug-type Pokémon in the tall grass.

label: ZKN_SUN_022_000
text:
It’s tough and has excellent stamina.
It has no problem flying continuously
for a whole day carrying a heavy load.

label: ZKN_SUN_025_000
text:
A plan was recently announced to gather
many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

label: ZKN_SUN_026_000
text:
It unleashes electric shocks that can reach
100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out
even an Indian elephant.

label: ZKN_SUN_027_000
text:
It can roll its body into a ball. It moves through
the desert by rolling at high speeds.

label: ZKN_SUN_028_000
text:
Although they are sharp, its claws and spikes
often break off. They grow back the next day,
so it is not bothered by the temporary loss.

label: ZKN_SUN_035_000
text:
Its adorable behavior and appearance make it
popular with men and women, young and old.
Its numbers are few, however.

label: ZKN_SUN_036_000
text:
They don’t like to reveal themselves in front of
people. They live quietly in packs deep in
the mountains.

label: ZKN_SUN_037_000
text:
Its beautiful fur and tails have made it very
popular. As it grows, its tails split to form
more tails.

label: ZKN_SUN_038_000
text:
Legend has it that this mystical Pokémon was
formed when nine saints coalesced into one.

label: ZKN_SUN_039_000
text:
It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a
mysterious melody. If you hear this melody,
you’ll become sleepy right away.

label: ZKN_SUN_040_000
text:
It sheds its fine fur when the seasons change.
The fur is gathered and spun into a
luxurious yarn.

label: ZKN_SUN_041_000
text:
It sleeps in caves during the day. It has no eyes,
so to check its surroundings while flying, it
emits ultrasonic waves.

label: ZKN_SUN_042_000
text:
Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making
them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are
specialized for sucking blood.

label: ZKN_SUN_046_000
text:
No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms
growing on its back steal away most of
the nutrients it consumes.

label: ZKN_SUN_047_000
text:
The large mushroom on its back controls it.
It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.

label: ZKN_SUN_050_000
text:
It chews on plant roots underground.
Farmers whose vegetables are vulnerable
find it can be quite a pest.

label: ZKN_SUN_051_000
text:
This set of triplets moves cooperatively.
It’s the power of teamwork that enables
this Pokémon to dig to a depth of 60 miles.

label: ZKN_SUN_052_000
text:
It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk.
At night, it wanders the city in search of
loose change.

label: ZKN_SUN_053_000
text:
It has a violent temperament. It will attack
anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp
claws inflict deep wounds.

label: ZKN_SUN_054_000
text:
As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it
to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without
meaning to.

label: ZKN_SUN_055_000
text:
It is said that the red part of its forehead
grants supernatural powers to those who
possess one, so it was over-hunted in the past.

label: ZKN_SUN_056_000
text:
It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone
near it clears out as it rampages, and the
resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

label: ZKN_SUN_057_000
text:
It has been known to become so angry that
it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in
death, however.

label: ZKN_SUN_058_000
text:
It’s both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries
to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.

label: ZKN_SUN_059_000
text:
Overflowing with beauty and majesty,
this strong Pokémon appears in ancient
Eastern folklore.

label: ZKN_SUN_060_000
text:
The swirl on its belly is its internal organs
showing through. If the swirl is tinged white,
that means it’s affected by some disease.

label: ZKN_SUN_061_000
text:
Although it can live on land, it prefers to stay in
the water, where it has fewer natural enemies.

label: ZKN_SUN_062_000
text:
Poliwrath in the Alola region are strong
swimmers that use the breaststroke. Many
children learn to swim by imitating Poliwrath.

label: ZKN_SUN_063_000
text:
It sleeps 18 hours a day. Even while sleeping,
it will teleport itself to treetops and pick and
eat berries there.

label: ZKN_SUN_064_000
text:
A theory exists that this Pokémon was a young
boy who couldn’t control his psychic powers
and ended up transformed into this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SUN_065_000
text:
It is said to have an IQ of approximately 5,000.
Its overflowing psychokinetic powers
cause headaches to anyone nearby.

label: ZKN_SUN_066_000
text:
It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles,
which continue to swell day by day, it becomes
more and more dedicated to its training.

label: ZKN_SUN_067_000
text:
As a result of its continual workouts, it has
developed tremendous power. It uses that
power to help people with their work.

label: ZKN_SUN_068_000
text:
It unleashes megaton-level punches that send
opponents flying clear over the horizon.

label: ZKN_SUN_072_000
text:
They can be found lying dehydrated on
beaches, but they are often still alive.
When soaked in water, they will revive.

label: ZKN_SUN_073_000
text:
Normally, it has 80 poisonous tentacles.
The longer one has been alive, the fewer
tentacles it will have.

label: ZKN_SUN_074_000
text:
Its round body makes it easy to pick up,
but it is hard and heavy. It’s dangerous
to play with them as if they were snowballs.

label: ZKN_SUN_075_000
text:
Mossy rocks are its favorite food.
It can devour a ton a day while crunching loudly.

label: ZKN_SUN_076_000
text:
Its body can survive dynamite blasts without
a single scratch, but it hates rain and humidity.

label: ZKN_SUN_079_000
text:
Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn’t really
feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back,
so Slowpoke isn’t particularly bothered.

label: ZKN_SUN_080_000
text:
It spaces out while gazing at the sea.
With Shellder’s poison flowing through its body,
it becomes even spacier.

label: ZKN_SUN_081_000
text:
They gather in places where electricity is
available. They can be found clinging to the
steel towers used to support power lines.

label: ZKN_SUN_082_000
text:
When three Magnemite link together, their brains
also become one. They do not become three
times more intelligent.

label: ZKN_SUN_088_000
text:
Its main source of food is the slimy industrial
waste of factories. This Pokémon’s numbers
have been decreasing in recent years.

label: ZKN_SUN_089_000
text:
The stench it gives off will make your nose
scrunch up. Still, there are Muk fans who think
that’s a good thing.

label: ZKN_SUN_090_000
text:
The hardness of its shell surpasses the
hardness of a diamond. In days gone by,
people used the shells to make shields.

label: ZKN_SUN_091_000
text:
Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even
by a bomb. The contents of the shell
remain unknown.

label: ZKN_SUN_092_000
text:
Should a strange light be seen flickering
in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.

label: ZKN_SUN_093_000
text:
It strikes at humans from total darkness.
Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker
with each passing day until they die.

label: ZKN_SUN_094_000
text:
Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden
chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar.
There is no escaping it. Give up.

label: ZKN_SUN_096_000
text:
A Pokémon that nourishes itself by eating
dreams, it is thought to share common ancestry
with Munna and Musharna.

label: ZKN_SUN_097_000
text:
While it is an extremely dangerous Pokémon,
people who are in need of a good, sound sleep
call it their savior.

label: ZKN_SUN_102_000
text:
Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate
among themselves. It is believed to carry
plant genes and the genes of other species.

label: ZKN_SUN_103_000
text:
Each of its heads has its own will. They use
telepathy to discuss their plans before coming
to a joint decision.

label: ZKN_SUN_104_000
text:
When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps
loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack
it from the air.

label: ZKN_SUN_105_000
text:
Originally, it was weak and timid. After evolution,
its temperament becomes violent, and it begins
to wield bones as weapons.

label: ZKN_SUN_113_000
text:
The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients
and a favorite food of many Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SUN_115_000
text:
Kangaskhan’s maternal love is so deep that it
will brave death to protect its offspring.

label: ZKN_SUN_118_000
text:
When the weather grows warm, they form
groups and swim upriver. This sight serves
as a poetic reminder that spring has arrived.

label: ZKN_SUN_119_000
text:
When the weather grows cold, its whole body
flushes a deep red. This sight serves as a
poetic reminder that autumn has arrived.

label: ZKN_SUN_120_000
text:
Large numbers of these Pokémon make their
home at the seaside. At night, a strange red
glow radiates from the center of their bodies.

label: ZKN_SUN_121_000
text:
Its shining core is thought to receive and
transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known
to cause headaches in those who approach it.

label: ZKN_SUN_123_000
text:
It confuses its prey with its quick, ninja-like
movements. Then, in an instant, it cleaves
them with its scythes.

label: ZKN_SUN_125_000
text:
Half of all sudden blackouts are caused
by Electabuzz gathering at electric power
plants and gobbling up electricity.

label: ZKN_SUN_126_000
text:
When it’s tired, it leaps into the mouth of a
volcano and soaks its body in magma to ease its
weariness. Its body burns at 2,192 degrees F.

label: ZKN_SUN_127_000
text:
It grips its prey in its pincers and splits them
apart. Although it is a powerful Pokémon, it
can’t deal with the cold.

label: ZKN_SUN_128_000
text:
Historically, people in areas all over the world
have ridden Tauros, but the practice is said to
have started in Alola.

label: ZKN_SUN_129_000
text:
Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is
incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes,
you’ll soon grow tired of seeing them.

label: ZKN_SUN_130_000
text:
A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados.
Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly
consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.

label: ZKN_SUN_131_000
text:
Its high intelligence enables it to comprehend
human speech. When it’s in a good mood,
it sings in its beautiful voice.

label: ZKN_SUN_132_000
text:
It can reorganize its cells to make itself into a
duplicate of anything it sees. The quality of the
duplicate depends on the individual.

label: ZKN_SUN_133_000
text:
Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic
makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

label: ZKN_SUN_134_000
text:
Its cells are composed of units much like water
molecules. It lives close to water and is often
mistaken for a mermaid.

label: ZKN_SUN_135_000
text:
They send out electrical charges of about
10,000 volts. Because they are high-strung,
it can be difficult to grow close to them.

label: ZKN_SUN_136_000
text:
When it catches prey or finds berries, it
breathes fire on them until they’re well done,
and then it gobbles them up.

label: ZKN_SUN_137_000
text:
Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created,
utilizing the latest technology of the time.

label: ZKN_SUN_142_000
text:
A Pokémon from the age of the dinosaurs.
It used its sawlike fangs to shred its prey
before eating them.

label: ZKN_SUN_143_000
text:
Its stomach is said to be incomparably strong.
Even Muk’s poison is nothing more than a hint of
spice on Snorlax’s tongue.

label: ZKN_SUN_147_000
text:
It grows by molting repeatedly. Boots made from
the tanned cast-off skin are a super luxury item.

label: ZKN_SUN_148_000
text:
It has long been thought that its crystalline
orbs are imbued with the power to control
the weather.

label: ZKN_SUN_149_000
text:
This Pokémon saved a shipwrecked man, taking
him to a remote island—a paradise occupied
solely by Dragonite.

label: ZKN_SUN_165_000
text:
They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a
swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on
their backs differs slightly from one to another.

label: ZKN_SUN_166_000
text:
While it’s believed that starlight provides it with
energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries.
In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.

label: ZKN_SUN_167_000
text:
It waits intently until its preferred prey, Cutiefly,
gets caught in its web. In fact, it’s quite a
patient Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SUN_168_000
text:
There are some areas where people use the
string Ariados spins for their own weaving.
The resulting cloth is popular for its strength.

label: ZKN_SUN_169_000
text:
Both its legs became wings, and as a result,
it can’t move well on the ground. All it can do
is crawl around.

label: ZKN_SUN_170_000
text:
Its two antennae were originally fins.
It discharges electricity to stun its prey
before attacking.

label: ZKN_SUN_171_000
text:
Should you peer into the ocean at night and see
a light shining like the stars, that is Lanturn.

label: ZKN_SUN_172_000
text:
It is not yet skilled at controlling electricity.
If you take your eyes off it, it may shock itself.

label: ZKN_SUN_173_000
text:
On late nights illuminated by shooting stars,
it gazes intently skyward, as if thinking of
its home.

label: ZKN_SUN_174_000
text:
It likes to sing but is not yet good at it.
With praise and encouragement, it will get
better little by little.

label: ZKN_SUN_185_000
text:
To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off
if splashed with water, which it hates.

label: ZKN_SUN_186_000
text:
They gather on moonlit nights to form a large
chorus. Their cries sound angry and not at all
pleasant, but they are certainly distinctive.

label: ZKN_SUN_196_000
text:
It can instantaneously sense its opponent’s
movements by feeling air currents with its
fine fur.

label: ZKN_SUN_197_000
text:
When this Pokémon becomes angry, its pores
secrete a poisonous sweat, which it sprays at
its opponent’s eyes.

label: ZKN_SUN_198_000
text:
They awaken at dusk and take wing in the
twilight, leading to the expression,
“Get home before the Murkrow fly.”

label: ZKN_SUN_199_000
text:
A poisonous bite reacted with its system,
blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a
genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.

label: ZKN_SUN_200_000
text:
It will use any means necessary to frighten
people and absorb their life energy. It practices
constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.

label: ZKN_SUN_209_000
text:
Despite its intimidating face, it’s quite cowardly.
Its desperate attempts to appear threatening
make it popular with people.

label: ZKN_SUN_210_000
text:
Its well-developed lower jaw and heavy fangs
are its weapons. As long as it’s not provoked,
it rarely bites.

label: ZKN_SUN_212_000
text:
It uses its wings to adjust its body temperature.
Otherwise, its metal body would become
too hot and melt in the heat of battle.

label: ZKN_SUN_215_000
text:
It has a cunning yet savage disposition.
It waits for parents to leave their nests,
and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

label: ZKN_SUN_222_000
text:
Coral branches grow from its head.
They break off quite easily, but they
grow back in about three days.

label: ZKN_SUN_225_000
text:
Although it naturally prefers colder locales,
Delibird in Alola seem able to withstand the
heat to a certain extent.

label: ZKN_SUN_227_000
text:
Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin
and sharp. In times long past, warriors used
them as swords.

label: ZKN_SUN_233_000
text:
For the purposes of planetary development,
Porygon was updated with the most
cutting-edge technology available.

label: ZKN_SUN_235_000
text:
The unique creations produced by each
Smeargle are painted using the fluid that oozes
from its tail. This is how it marks its territory.

label: ZKN_SUN_239_000
text:
When it’s in a house, electrical outlets serve as
its baby bottles. It sucks down electricity.

label: ZKN_SUN_240_000
text:
Many of these Pokémon can be seen in areas
with volcanic activity. Feeding can get them so
excited, they exhale flames of 1,100 degrees F.

label: ZKN_SUN_241_000
text:
Its milk is high in calories and packed with
nutrients. Therefore, if you drink too much of it,
you may wind up with a body like Miltank’s.

label: ZKN_SUN_242_000
text:
Even the most ferocious Pokémon become calm
when they eat Blissey’s egg, which is said
to be filled with happiness.

label: ZKN_SUN_278_000
text:
Its hollow bones enhance its lightness.
It spreads its wings to the wind and soars away
into the sky.

label: ZKN_SUN_279_000
text:
Its spacious beak is large enough for a
small child to fit right inside.

label: ZKN_SUN_283_000
text:
It moves as if skating on the surface of the
water. It often fights with Dewpider over food.

label: ZKN_SUN_284_000
text:
It intimidates enemies with the eye-like
patterns on its antennae. Its four wings
allow it to fly in any direction.

label: ZKN_SUN_296_000
text:
It was originally brought in from another region,
but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.

label: ZKN_SUN_297_000
text:
It is known for its fantastic strength, but as it
grows older, it focuses more on
training Makuhita.

label: ZKN_SUN_299_000
text:
The magnet in Nosepass’s nose provides an
unerring compass, making it an excellent
partner for Trainers going on a journey.

label: ZKN_SUN_302_000
text:
It’s a fiend for gemstones, so it stalks Carbink.
Unfortunately, Gabite almost always grabs
them first.

label: ZKN_SUN_318_000
text:
Each school has its own territory. Any intruders
are mercilessly attacked with fangs bared.

label: ZKN_SUN_319_000
text:
It pursues its prey at speeds of 75 mph and
finishes them off with fangs that can crush iron.
It is known as the bully of the sea.

label: ZKN_SUN_320_000
text:
It loves to startle people. It fills itself up with
seawater and plays by bouncing around like
a ball.

label: ZKN_SUN_321_000
text:
Wailord pursue their prey in pods. With their
large mouths, they can swallow entire schools
of Wishiwashi whole.

label: ZKN_SUN_324_000
text:
Coal is the source of Torkoal’s energy. Large
amounts of coal can be found in the mountains
where they live.

label: ZKN_SUN_327_000
text:
Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but
Spinda thinks it’s walking in a straight line.

label: ZKN_SUN_328_000
text:
It can live for a week without eating a thing.
It waits patiently at the bottom of its nest for
prey to appear.

label: ZKN_SUN_329_000
text:
Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for
flight, it rubs them together, producing
ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.

label: ZKN_SUN_330_000
text:
The flapping of its wings sounds something like
singing. Those lured by the sound are enveloped
in a sandstorm, becoming Flygon’s prey.

label: ZKN_SUN_339_000
text:
Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar.
Even in muddy waters, it can detect its
prey’s location.

label: ZKN_SUN_340_000
text:
A glutton that devours anything that moves,
it quietly lurks at the bottom of swamps,
lying in wait for prey.

label: ZKN_SUN_349_000
text:
A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even
in dirty water. However, due to its ragged,
shabby appearance, it isn’t popular.

label: ZKN_SUN_350_000
text:
Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists.
It has even been referred to as the most
beautiful Pokémon of all.

label: ZKN_SUN_351_000
text:
It changes its form depending on the weather.
Changes in the temperature or humidity
appear to affect its cellular structure.

label: ZKN_SUN_359_000
text:
Long ago, superstitions were spread about it,
saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred
of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.

label: ZKN_SUN_361_000
text:
Their numbers seem to have rapidly increased in
Alola. Custom has it that houses where Snorunt
live will be prosperous for generations to come.

label: ZKN_SUN_362_000
text:
Legend says a boulder on an icy mountain
absorbed the distress and regrets of a
stranded mountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.

label: ZKN_SUN_369_000
text:
Its form has remained the same for one hundred
million years. Its body is filled with fat, so it can
withstand the water pressure of the deep sea.

label: ZKN_SUN_370_000
text:
If a Luvdisc is left on its own, it becomes
despondent, leaving itself open to attack.
That is when Pelipper snatch them up.

label: ZKN_SUN_371_000
text:
Its belief that it will be able to fly one day
is apparently the influence of information
carried in its genes.

label: ZKN_SUN_372_000
text:
The cells within its shell transform with
explosive speed, preparing it for evolution.

label: ZKN_SUN_373_000
text:
When angered, it loses all sense of itself and
destroys everything around it. The destruction
will continue until Salamence has tired itself out.

label: ZKN_SUN_374_000
text:
Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism
to communicate with others of its kind.

label: ZKN_SUN_375_000
text:
When two Beldum link together, their psychic
power is doubled. Their intelligence, however,
remains unchanged.

label: ZKN_SUN_376_000
text:
It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and
large body. Then the teeth in the mouth on its
stomach chew the prey to bits.

label: ZKN_SUN_408_000
text:
It lived in jungles around a hundred million years
ago. It used its skillful headbutts to
combat Aerodactyl.

label: ZKN_SUN_409_000
text:
The result of repeated headbutts is a skull
grown thick and hard. However, its brain has
shrunk in size compared with Cranidos’s.

label: ZKN_SUN_410_000
text:
Many fossils of this Pokémon have been found,
but almost none have shown signs of damage
to the face.

label: ZKN_SUN_411_000
text:
While it can guard against any sort of attack
from the front, it is left without recourse when
attacked from behind.

label: ZKN_SUN_422_000
text:
For the most part, it makes its home along
the seashore. Its color and form differ according
to its habitat and the quality of its food.

label: ZKN_SUN_423_000
text:
It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if
parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will
return to normal within a few hours.

label: ZKN_SUN_425_000
text:
Stories go that it grabs the hands of small
children and drags them away to the afterlife.
It dislikes heavy children.

label: ZKN_SUN_426_000
text:
There was once an incident in which a man
took a trip riding a Drifblim, only to go missing.

label: ZKN_SUN_429_000
text:
It appears as if from nowhere—muttering
incantations, placing curses, and giving
people terrifying visions.

label: ZKN_SUN_430_000
text:
A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and
more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies
will assemble.

label: ZKN_SUN_438_000
text:
It does not deal well with water, so it lives in dry
locales. Since its surroundings tend to lack
greenery, it stands out noticeably.

label: ZKN_SUN_440_000
text:
It carries a round white rock in its belly pouch.
If it gets along well with someone, it will
sometimes give that person the rock.

label: ZKN_SUN_443_000
text:
It lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat.
Even so, when the weather gets cold, it will
huddle close with others of its kind.

label: ZKN_SUN_444_000
text:
In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales.
Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient
will make a weary body feel invigorated.

label: ZKN_SUN_445_000
text:
It can fly at speeds rivaling jet planes.
It dives into flocks of bird Pokémon and
gulps the entire flock down whole.

label: ZKN_SUN_446_000
text:
It needs to consume its own weight in food
every day. As far as flavor is concerned,
it’s indifferent.

label: ZKN_SUN_447_000
text:
It can discern the physical and emotional states
of people, Pokémon, and other natural things
from the shape of their aura waves.

label: ZKN_SUN_448_000
text:
Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also
gained the power to control them. It employs
them in battle.

label: ZKN_SUN_456_000
text:
It absorbs sunlight with the pink areas of its
skin, which then shine. This appears to be a
form of camouflage.

label: ZKN_SUN_457_000
text:
With its shining light, it lures its prey close.
However, the light also happens to attract
ferocious fish Pokémon—its natural predators.

label: ZKN_SUN_461_000
text:
They travel in groups of four or five, leaving
signs for one another on trees and rocks. They
bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

label: ZKN_SUN_462_000
text:
Three units generate magnetism. There have
been many mistaken reports of UFO sightings
when Magnezone flies through the night sky.

label: ZKN_SUN_466_000
text:
It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes
and then lets loose a high-voltage current.
Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.

label: ZKN_SUN_467_000
text:
They dwell in volcanic craters. According to
what is known, a single pair of male and female
Magmortar lives in one volcano.

label: ZKN_SUN_470_000
text:
Its cellular composition is closer to that of a
plant than an animal. It uses photosynthesis to
produce its energy supply without eating food.

label: ZKN_SUN_471_000
text:
It can control its body temperature at will.
This enables it to freeze the moisture in the
atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

label: ZKN_SUN_474_000
text:
In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an
additional program was installed, but apparently
it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.

label: ZKN_SUN_476_000
text:
It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that
nearby electrical appliances become unusable.

label: ZKN_SUN_478_000
text:
When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes,
it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den,
where they become decorations.

label: ZKN_SUN_506_000
text:
Because it doesn’t yelp, it’s extremely popular
with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

label: ZKN_SUN_507_000
text:
Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high
cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed
makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

label: ZKN_SUN_508_000
text:
Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant,
it’s a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.

label: ZKN_SUN_524_000
text:
Born deep within the ground, it compares itself
with similar species, such as Geodude and
Carbink, to settle which has the hardest body.

label: ZKN_SUN_525_000
text:
Its orange crystal is a mass of energy.
Just one crystal fragment would provide
enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.

label: ZKN_SUN_526_000
text:
The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams
have terrifying power. However, it’s not able to
fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.

label: ZKN_SUN_546_000
text:
When it finds others of its kind, they all stick
together. When enough of them have collected,
the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

label: ZKN_SUN_547_000
text:
It rides on the wind and slips into people’s
homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-
filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

label: ZKN_SUN_548_000
text:
Although the leaves on its head are bitter
enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief
from weariness—even more so when boiled.

label: ZKN_SUN_549_000
text:
No matter how much time and money is spent
raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful
when they bloom in the wild.

label: ZKN_SUN_551_000
text:
It submerges itself in sand and moves as if
swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies
from finding it and maintains its temperature.

label: ZKN_SUN_552_000
text:
They move in groups of a few individuals.
A female is often the leader of the group, and
the males will gather food.

label: ZKN_SUN_553_000
text:
Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey
more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of
a sandstorm.

label: ZKN_SUN_564_000
text:
Based on studies of its skeletal structure, it can
apparently dive to ocean depths of over half
a mile.

label: ZKN_SUN_565_000
text:
It constructed its sturdy shell by crunching and
swallowing the hard shells or bones of its prey.

label: ZKN_SUN_566_000
text:
It is the ancestor of all bird Pokémon. Archen
itself could not actually fly but moved by
hopping from treetop to treetop.

label: ZKN_SUN_567_000
text:
Although apparently able to fly, they tended
to run along the ground, averaging speeds of
roughly 25 mph.

label: ZKN_SUN_568_000
text:
Unsanitary places are what they like best.
They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer
in hot pursuit.

label: ZKN_SUN_569_000
text:
Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its
right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you’ll
experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.

label: ZKN_SUN_582_000
text:
Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty
breath to make ice crystals, causing snow
to fall.

label: ZKN_SUN_583_000
text:
Hot days cause its body to melt. It can be
restored by refreezing it, but the process
leaves its body slightly warped.

label: ZKN_SUN_584_000
text:
Each of its two heads has a brain, and when
they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies
by exhaling a violent blizzard.

label: ZKN_SUN_587_000
text:
It glides using its cape-like membrane.
Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking
its friends and foes alike.

label: ZKN_SUN_594_000
text:
It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of
injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior
remains unknown.

label: ZKN_SUN_627_000
text:
They pick fights indiscriminately. They grow
stronger and more powerful each time they
faint or are injured.

label: ZKN_SUN_628_000
text:
With its brave disposition, it fears nothing—not
even death. Ancient Alolan people respected
it, referring to it as “the hero of the sky.”

label: ZKN_SUN_629_000
text:
It protects its plump posterior with the bones
of prey it has consumed. As it grows, it 
replaces the bones.

label: ZKN_SUN_630_000
text:
They adorn themselves beautifully with bones.
This is supposedly an effort to attract males,
but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.

label: ZKN_SUN_661_000
text:
This amiable Pokémon is easy to train.
But when battle is joined, it shows its
ferocious side.

label: ZKN_SUN_662_000
text:
From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once
it has caught them, it grills them at high heat
before feasting upon them.

label: ZKN_SUN_663_000
text:
Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek.
It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them
firmly in its talons.

label: ZKN_SUN_674_000
text:
It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro,
which it looks up to as a leader.

label: ZKN_SUN_675_000
text:
It boasts superb physical strength. Those who
wish to become Pangoro’s Trainer have no
choice but to converse with their fists.

label: ZKN_SUN_700_000
text:
Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura that
weakens hostility in its prey, causing them
to let down their guard. Then it attacks.

label: ZKN_SUN_703_000
text:
Born from the high temperatures and pressures
deep underground, it defends itself by firing
beams from the jewel part of its body.

label: ZKN_SUN_704_000
text:
The weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon,
it’s unable to breathe if its skin dries out,
so it sticks to shady places.

label: ZKN_SUN_705_000
text:
It has trouble drawing a line between friends
and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even
those it gets along well with.

label: ZKN_SUN_706_000
text:
An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to
itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes
gooey tears.

label: ZKN_SUN_707_000
text:
This even-tempered Pokémon has a habit of
collecting keys. It will sneak into people’s homes
to steal their keys.

label: ZKN_SUN_708_000
text:
These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the
spirits of children who died in the forest.
Their cries sound like eerie screams.

label: ZKN_SUN_709_000
text:
This Pokémon is said to devour anyone daring to
ravage the forest. To the creatures dwelling in
the forest, it offers great kindness.

label: ZKN_SUN_718_000
text:
This is Zygarde’s form when it has gathered
50% of its cells. It wipes out all those who
oppose it, showing not a shred of mercy.

label: ZKN_SUN_722_000
text:
This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to
store up energy during the day, while becoming
active at night.

label: ZKN_SUN_723_000
text:
A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time
preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any
dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

label: ZKN_SUN_724_000
text:
It fires arrow quills from its wings with such
precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances
over a hundred yards.

label: ZKN_SUN_725_000
text:
While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its
stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery
attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

label: ZKN_SUN_726_000
text:
At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings
brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

label: ZKN_SUN_727_000
text:
This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition.
If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its
Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.

label: ZKN_SUN_728_000
text:
This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose,
blowing balloons to smash into its foes.
It’s famous for being a hard worker.

label: ZKN_SUN_729_000
text:
A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water
balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards
its enemies.

label: ZKN_SUN_730_000
text:
It controls its water balloons with song. The
melody is learned from others of its kind and is
passed down from one generation to the next.

label: ZKN_SUN_731_000
text:
It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to
drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food
storage and for nesting.

label: ZKN_SUN_732_000
text:
It eats berries and stores their seeds in its
beak. When it encounters enemies or prey,
it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

label: ZKN_SUN_733_000
text:
When it battles, its beak heats up. The
temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees
Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.

label: ZKN_SUN_734_000
text:
With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything.
It did not originally live in Alola but was
imported from another region.

label: ZKN_SUN_735_000
text:
When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently
stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing
by nightfall.

label: ZKN_SUN_736_000
text:
Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and
slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.

label: ZKN_SUN_737_000
text:
Its body is capable of storing electricity. On
camping trips, people are grateful to have
one around.

label: ZKN_SUN_738_000
text:
It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening.
It concentrates electrical energy within its large
jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

label: ZKN_SUN_739_000
text:
While guarding its weak points with its pincers,
it looks for an opening and unleashes punches.
When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

label: ZKN_SUN_740_000
text:
It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up
on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure
the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

label: ZKN_SUN_741_000
text:
It beats its wings together to create fire.
As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance,
it bathes opponents in intense flames.

label: ZKN_SUN_742_000
text:
It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers.
Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify
which flowers are about to bloom.

label: ZKN_SUN_743_000
text:
It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many
different varieties, some used as food and
others used in battle.

label: ZKN_SUN_744_000
text:
It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for
beginners because of its friendliness, but its
disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

label: ZKN_SUN_745_000
text:
Its quick movements confuse its enemies.
Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses
the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

label: ZKN_SUN_746_000
text:
When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin
to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades,
and they stand together against their enemies.

label: ZKN_SUN_747_000
text:
It plunges the poison spike on its head into its
prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie
deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

label: ZKN_SUN_748_000
text:
Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its
12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits
scattered in its wake.

label: ZKN_SUN_749_000
text:
The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances
its grip and its powerful running gait.

label: ZKN_SUN_750_000
text:
It spits a mud that provides resistance to both
wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were
often coated with it.

label: ZKN_SUN_751_000
text:
It crawls onto the land in search of food.
Its water bubble allows it to breathe and
protects its soft head.

label: ZKN_SUN_752_000
text:
It delivers headbutts with the water bubble
on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into
the bubble, where they drown.

label: ZKN_SUN_753_000
text:
During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light.
When night falls, it walks around looking
for a safer place to sleep.

label: ZKN_SUN_754_000
text:
It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s
vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this
work and treat it as their hobby.

label: ZKN_SUN_755_000
text:
It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone
seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

label: ZKN_SUN_756_000
text:
Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to
enter at night. People confused by its strange
lights can never find their way home again.

label: ZKN_SUN_757_000
text:
It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous
gas. When its enemies become disoriented from
inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

label: ZKN_SUN_758_000
text:
For some reason, only females have been found.
It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that
it lives with.

label: ZKN_SUN_759_000
text:
Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets
angry and flails about, its arms and legs could
knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

label: ZKN_SUN_760_000
text:
This immensely dangerous Pokémon
possesses overwhelming physical strength.
Its habitat is generally off-limits.

label: ZKN_SUN_761_000
text:
A delectable aroma pours from its body.
They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon
lured by that wafting deliciousness.

label: ZKN_SUN_762_000
text:
The sepals on its head developed to protect its
body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked
by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

label: ZKN_SUN_763_000
text:
Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to
be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off
by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

label: ZKN_SUN_764_000
text:
It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine.
This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off
an aromatic scent.

label: ZKN_SUN_765_000
text:
Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon
will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s
best suited to veteran Trainers.

label: ZKN_SUN_766_000
text:
They form groups of roughly 20 individuals.
Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never
let down a comrade.

label: ZKN_SUN_767_000
text:
This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately
dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a
sparkling clean path in its wake.

label: ZKN_SUN_768_000
text:
With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws,
it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

label: ZKN_SUN_769_000
text:
Born from a sand mound playfully built by a
child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of
the departed.

label: ZKN_SUN_770_000
text:
Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon
transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it
evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

label: ZKN_SUN_771_000
text:
It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a
beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it
uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

label: ZKN_SUN_772_000
text:
The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its
intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some
hidden special power.

label: ZKN_SUN_773_000
text:
Its trust in its partner is what awakens it.
This Pokémon is capable of changing its type,
a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.

label: ZKN_SUN_774_000
text:
Originally making its home in the ozone layer,
it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing
its body grows too heavy.

label: ZKN_SUN_775_000
text:
It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its
movements are apparently no more than the
results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

label: ZKN_SUN_776_000
text:
The shell on its back is chemically unstable
and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its
stomach is its weak point.

label: ZKN_SUN_777_000
text:
The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest.
When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur
stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

label: ZKN_SUN_778_000
text:
Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar
who saw what was under its rag was
overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

label: ZKN_SUN_779_000
text:
When it unleashes its psychic power from the
protuberance on its head, the grating sound
of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

label: ZKN_SUN_780_000
text:
It has a compassionate personality, but if it is
angered, it completely destroys its surroundings
with its intense breath.

label: ZKN_SUN_781_000
text:
Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord
in a single blow. What appears to be green
seaweed is actually its body.

label: ZKN_SUN_782_000
text:
It expresses its feelings by smacking
its scales. Metallic sounds echo through
the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

label: ZKN_SUN_783_000
text:
It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout.
Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

label: ZKN_SUN_784_000
text:
When it spots enemies, it threatens them by
jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents
will crack and flee in panic.

label: ZKN_SUN_785_000
text:
This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with
curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores
their lightning inside its body.

label: ZKN_SUN_786_000
text:
This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel.
The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of
its energy.

label: ZKN_SUN_787_000
text:
It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings
them around. It causes vegetation to grow,
and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

label: ZKN_SUN_788_000
text:
The dense fog it creates brings the downfall
and destruction of its confused enemies.
Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

label: ZKN_SUN_789_000
text:
Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as
it collects dust from the atmosphere.

label: ZKN_SUN_790_000
text:
Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to
the touch. In the distant past, it was called the
cocoon of the stars.

label: ZKN_SUN_791_000
text:
It is said to live in another world. The intense
light it radiates from the surface of its body can
make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

label: ZKN_SUN_792_000
text:
It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog.
When its third eye activates, away it flies to
another world.

label: ZKN_SUN_793_000
text:
One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People
on the street report observing those infested
by it suddenly becoming violent.

label: ZKN_SUN_794_000
text:
This Ultra Beast appeared from another world.
It shows off its body, but whether that display
is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

label: ZKN_SUN_795_000
text:
One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been
spotted running across the land at
terrific speeds.

label: ZKN_SUN_796_000
text:
One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra
Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate
from its entire body, according to witnesses.

label: ZKN_SUN_797_000
text:
It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses
observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

label: ZKN_SUN_798_000
text:
This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole.
It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but
its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

label: ZKN_SUN_799_000
text:
It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole
buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the
Ultra Beasts.

label: ZKN_SUN_800_000
text:
Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form,
apparently asleep underground, is thought to
have come from another world in ancient times.

label: ZKN_SUN_801_000
text:
This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than
500 years ago, can understand human speech
but cannot itself speak.

label: ZKN_SUN_802_000
text:
Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never
appears before humans, so its very existence
was the stuff of myth.

label: ZKN_SUN_019_001
text:
With its incisors, it gnaws through doors and
infiltrates people’s homes. Then, with a twitch
of its whiskers, it steals whatever food it finds.

label: ZKN_SUN_020_001
text:
It forms a group of Rattata, which it assumes
command of. Each group has its own territory,
and disputes over food happen often.

label: ZKN_SUN_025_001
text:
This form of Pikachu is somewhat rare. It wears
the hat of its Trainer, who is also its partner.

label: ZKN_SUN_025_002
text:
This form of Pikachu is somewhat rare. It wears
the hat of its Trainer, who is also its partner.

label: ZKN_SUN_025_003
text:
This form of Pikachu is somewhat rare. It wears
the hat of its Trainer, who is also its partner.

label: ZKN_SUN_025_004
text:
This form of Pikachu is somewhat rare. It wears
the hat of its Trainer, who is also its partner.

label: ZKN_SUN_025_005
text:
This form of Pikachu is somewhat rare. It wears
the hat of its Trainer, who is also its partner.

label: ZKN_SUN_025_006
text:
This form of Pikachu is somewhat rare. It wears
the hat of its Trainer, who is also its partner.

label: ZKN_SUN_026_001
text:
It only evolves to this form in the Alola region.
According to researchers, its diet is one of the
causes of this change.

label: ZKN_SUN_027_001
text:
It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is
very hard—so much so, it can’t roll its body up
into a ball.

label: ZKN_SUN_028_001
text:
Fleeing a volcanic eruption, it settled on a snowy
mountain. As it races through the snowfields,
it sends up a spray of snow.

label: ZKN_SUN_037_001
text:
It exhales air colder than -58 degrees
Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this
Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

label: ZKN_SUN_038_001
text:
It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers
them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it
will be frozen stiff in an instant.

label: ZKN_SUN_050_001
text:
Its head sports an altered form of whiskers
made of metal. When in communication with its
comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

label: ZKN_SUN_051_001
text:
Its shining gold hair provides it with protection.
It’s reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs
will bring bad luck.

label: ZKN_SUN_052_001
text:
This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola.
Human actions caused a surge in their numbers,
and they went feral. They’re prideful and crafty.

label: ZKN_SUN_053_001
text:
Its round face and smooth coat—softer than the
most high-class velvet—have made this a very
popular Pokémon in Alola.

label: ZKN_SUN_065_001
text:
As a result of Mega Evolution, its power has
been entirely converted into psychic energy,
and it has lost all strength in its muscles.

label: ZKN_SUN_074_001
text:
Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches
firmly to the portions of its body that are
particularly magnetic.

label: ZKN_SUN_075_001
text:
Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten
this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon,
rising to the surface of part of its body.

label: ZKN_SUN_076_001
text:
It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if
the rock isn’t fired that accurately, just grazing
an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

label: ZKN_SUN_080_001
text:
All the energy from Mega Evolution poured into
the Shellder on its tail, leaving Slowpoke to be
swallowed whole.

label: ZKN_SUN_088_001
text:
A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a
problem with garbage, developed over time into
this form.

label: ZKN_SUN_089_001
text:
The garbage it eats causes continuous chemical
changes in its body, which produce its
exceedingly vivid coloration.

label: ZKN_SUN_094_001
text:
Gengar’s relationships are warped. It has no
interest in opponents unless it perceives them
as prey.

label: ZKN_SUN_103_001
text:
Alola is the best environment for this Pokémon.
Local people take pride in its appearance,
saying this is how Exeggutor ought to look.

label: ZKN_SUN_105_001
text:
The bones it possesses were once its mother’s.
Its mother’s regrets have become like a vengeful
spirit protecting this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SUN_115_001
text:
Mega Kangaskhan’s strength derives from the
mother’s happiness about her child’s growth.
Watching it grow up keeps her spirits high.

label: ZKN_SUN_127_001
text:
The influence of Mega Evolution leaves it in a
state of constant excitement. It pierces enemies
with its two large horns before shredding them.

label: ZKN_SUN_130_001
text:
Mega Evolution also affects its brain, leaving
no other function except its destructive instinct
to burn everything to cinders.

label: ZKN_SUN_142_001
text:
Part of its body has become stone. Some
scholars claim that this is Aerodactyl’s
true appearance.

label: ZKN_SUN_212_001
text:
The excess energy that bathes this Pokémon
keeps it in constant danger of overflow. It can’t
sustain a battle over long periods of time.

label: ZKN_SUN_302_001
text:
The jewel from its chest, which has grown
gigantic due to the effects of Mega Evolution,
can turn back any attack.

label: ZKN_SUN_319_001
text:
The spines sprouting from its head are
transformed fangs. If they’re injured or broken
off, the spines will regenerate countless times.

label: ZKN_SUN_351_001
text:
This is the form Castform takes on the
brightest of days. Its skin is unexpectedly hot
to the touch, so approach with care.

label: ZKN_SUN_351_002
text:
This is the form Castform takes when soaked
with rain. When its body is compressed, water
will seep out as if from a sponge.

label: ZKN_SUN_351_003
text:
This is the form Castform takes when covered
in snow. Its body becomes an ice-like material,
with a temperature near 23 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SUN_359_001
text:
When this Pokémon whips the winglike fur on its
back as though beating its wings, it sends an
intimidating aura flying at its opponents.

label: ZKN_SUN_362_001
text:
The excess energy from Mega Evolution spilled
over from its mouth, breaking its jaw. It spews
endless blizzards.

label: ZKN_SUN_373_001
text:
Anyone standing in its path gets sliced right in
two, while this Pokémon continues its flight
without interruption.

label: ZKN_SUN_376_001
text:
This form results from one Metagross,
one Metang, and two Beldum linking up.

label: ZKN_SUN_422_001
text:
Shellos lives in the sea and feasts on plankton.
The lovelier the ocean where Shellos resides,
the more vibrant its color becomes.

label: ZKN_SUN_423_001
text:
A team of researchers is scouring the oceans
of the world in search of a Gastrodon in a color
never seen before.

label: ZKN_SUN_445_001
text:
Excess energy melted its arms and wings,
transforming them into giant scythes.

label: ZKN_SUN_448_001
text:
Black streaks all over its body show where
its auras and the energy of Mega Evolution
intermingled and raced through it.

label: ZKN_SUN_718_001
text:
Its sharp fangs make short work of finishing off
its enemies, but it’s unable to maintain this body
indefinitely. After a period of time, it falls apart.

label: ZKN_SUN_718_003
text:
This is Zygarde’s form when it has gathered
50% of its cells. It wipes out all those who
oppose it, showing not a shred of mercy.

label: ZKN_SUN_718_004
text:
This is Zygarde’s form at times when it uses
its overwhelming power to suppress those who
endanger the ecosystem.

label: ZKN_SUN_741_001
text:
This Oricorio has sipped bright yellow nectar.
Its bright, cheerful dance melts the hearts of
its enemies.

label: ZKN_SUN_741_002
text:
This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This
increases its psychic energy, which it then fires
at its enemies.

label: ZKN_SUN_741_003
text:
This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Its
elegant, attractive dance will send the minds
and hearts of its enemies to another world.

label: ZKN_SUN_745_001
text:
The more intimidating the opponent it faces,
the more this Pokémon’s blood boils.
It will attack with no regard for its own safety.

label: ZKN_SUN_746_001
text:
Weak Wishiwashi school together to concentrate
their power. Their united force makes them the
demon of the sea, feared near and far.
